title: Migrating to HTTPX2
summary: A migration guide for the OpenAI Python SDK transitioning from httpx v1 to HTTPX2, documenting the API changes and compatibility considerations for developers using the official OpenAI library.
problem_solved: Enables developers to migrate their OpenAI Python integrations to the newer HTTPX2 client with improved async capabilities and performance.
why_valuable: As one of the most widely used Python libraries for AI API access, this migration ensures better async support and future-proofs applications built on the OpenAI SDK.
